item.title: Synergistic Molecular Interfacial Bridging and Solvation Structure Regulation for High‐Performance Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Pantolactone is introduced as a multifunctional electrolyte additive that forms a molecular-bridge interface layer on the Zn anode while coordinating Zn2+ to reconstruct its solvation sheath. This dual strategy accelerates desolvation, guides Zn(002) deposition, and suppresses water activity and side reactions, enabling over 3400 h cycling and 94.1% capacity retention, offering a new paradigm coupling interfacial engineering with solvation regulation for AZIBs.
